test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2nd December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Ramesh invested 30% more than Suresh. Suresh invested 40% less than Arun who invested Rs. 8,000. Find the difference in the amounts (in Rs.) invested by Ramesh and Suresh.
solution:
Given:

Ramesh invested = 130% × Suresh invested

Suresh invested = 60% × Arun invested

Arun invested = Rs. 8,000

Calculation:

Suresh invested = 60% × 8000

⇒ Rs. 4800

Ramesh invested = 130% × 4800

⇒ Rs. 6240

Now, Difference in the investments by Ramesh and Suresh

⇒ 6240 - 4800 =Rs. 1440 

**∴ The difference in the amounts invested by Ramesh and Suresh** **is Rs. 1440.**
